            <p>
                Eco Farm promotes environmentally friendly
                farming practices that help protect nature
                and support sustainable food production.
                It encourages growing vegetables and fruits,
                composting organic waste, and conserving
                natural resources.
            </p>

            <p style="margin-top: 12px;">
                Located in the beautiful municipality of
                Tigbauan, Iloilo, an eco-farm concept

            </p>
